title: RevOps AI Readiness Suite — Dual-Output Artifact
description: The machine-readable half of every tool's dual output. One JSON per run, written to readiness-output/<team>/<tool-id>.json. The branded HTML deliverable is rendered from this same object, so the two artifacts cannot drift. RevOps consumer tools (semantic-reconciler, control-plane-blueprint, org-wide-roadmap) ingest these files from other tools.

id.description: Stable tool/skill id, e.g. 'cs-intent-scope-mapper'. Matches the skill folder name.

kind.description: readiness = assessment/diagnostic; activation = drafts a human-owned artifact; synthesis = RevOps tool consuming other tools' JSON.

inputs.description: What the operator supplied this run.

ref.description: Filename, URL, or upstream artifact id.

headline.description: One-line plain-language verdict. Actionable, not a score.

narrative.description: 2-4 sentence framing of what was assessed and the single most important next step.

ai_ready.description: Whether this dimension is ready for a safe AI first step. null when not a yes/no question.

blocking_count.description: Number of findings that must be fixed before an AI first step is safe.

stats.description: Headline figures for the deliverable's stat band.

findings.description: Actionable changes. Each finding tells the operator exactly what to fix and why it blocks a safe AI step. Used by readiness/synthesis tools.

why_it_blocks_ai.description: The AI-readiness consequence of leaving it unfixed.

the_fix.description: Concrete, ordered steps a human takes to remediate.

affected.description: Entities implicated (article URLs, stage names, field names, records).

evidence.description: The data point that triggered this finding.

owner_role.description: Suggested human owner of the fix.

definitions.description: Glossary terms for the semantic layer. Emitted by tools that touch shared definitions (MQL, qualified, customer, churn, ARR). The semantic-reconciler ingests these across teams to surface conflicts.

derived_from.description: Field/report/source the definition was inferred from.

drafts.description: Human-owned draft artifacts produced by activation tools. NEVER sent or written anywhere by the tool — the operator copies/uses them.

content.description: The draft text. Markdown allowed; rendered into the deliverable.

grounded_on.description: Citations / sources the draft is grounded on.

flags.description: Explicit caveats, e.g. 'Current KB cannot answer part 2 of this question.'

codex.description: Marketing brand codex payload. Emitted by mkt-brand-codex-builder and consumed by distinctiveness-guard and on-brand-content-drafter.

consumed_artifacts.description: For synthesis tools: which upstream JSON artifacts fed this run.

roadmap.description: Prioritised, sequenced actions for the capstone org-wide-roadmap. Each item traces a team-level symptom to a root RevOps-level cause.

root_cause.description: The RevOps-level cause behind the surface symptoms.

symptoms.description: Team-level findings this action resolves, ideally referencing source tool ids.

conflicts.description: Cross-team definition conflicts surfaced by the semantic-reconciler.

impact.description: What breaks for an AI agent when these disagree.

disclaimers.description: e.g. compliance content labelled 'Guidance, not legal advice.'
